lines: +callisto-cli: patch

+**Retrying `version` finishes when its emitted decision is inside the workspace.** A run that wrote `--emit-decision` or `--emit-preview` into `.changeset` and was then interrupted no longer refuses its own retry with `E340`.
+- A hand edit to that file after the interruption is still refused.
+callisto-cli: minor
+**Generated release workflows publish only what a credential-free job built.** Package scripts, build backends and crate builds no longer run in the job that holds your registry tokens.

+- The publish job uploads exactly the Python files and npm tarballs a job without credentials built and sealed, and publishes crates with `cargo publish --no-verify` after that job compiled every crate of the release, one `cargo package --locked` call per Cargo workspace, including a workspace under a directory such as `native/` with no root manifest.

+- The simple workflow now has `version-pr`, `package` and `execute` jobs, and the build-matrix workflow gains `attest`, `package-cargo` and `pack-npm` jobs, so only `execute` holds secrets and only the attestation job holds an OIDC token without checking out your code.
+- npm packages are packed by their workspace's own package manager, so `workspace:` and `catalog:` ranges are rewritten in the published tarball.
+- A local `callisto release` still verifies crates and packs in place, with registry credentials withheld from the build.

+**Breaking:** npm publishes now run `npm publish <tarball> --ignore-scripts`. The `prepublishOnly`, `publish` and `postpublish` hooks no longer run, and `prepack` and `prepare` run in the pack job, which has no registry credentials. The simple workflow now publishes only when a push adds or changes the release decision file, not whenever an untagged version is merged. A release whose npm or PyPI publish is not sealed in the artifact manifest now fails with E306 before anything is published.

+**Breaking:** `npm publish <tarball>` does not read a registry set in `.yarnrc.yml` or `bunfig.toml`. A yarn workspace whose `.yarnrc.yml` sets `npmPublishRegistry` or `npmRegistryServer` (at the top level or under `npmScopes`), or a bun workspace whose `bunfig.toml` sets a registry, now fails with E168 before anything is published, and Yarn and Bun token settings are not used either.

+**Action:** Yarn and Bun users: move the registry to `publishConfig.registry` in your package's `package.json`, or to `.npmrc`, and keep the publish token in `NPM_TOKEN`. Everyone: delete `.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml` and regenerate it with `callisto init --workflow`, then move work that must run at publish time from `prepublishOnly`, `publish` or `postpublish` into `prepack` or a step of your own after `execute`.
+callisto-cli: patch

+**Fixed groups no longer leak provisional versions into dependency ranges.** When a fixed group aligned its members to a lower version than a member's own bump, a dependent's requirement could be rewritten to the provisional version, widening a range, or rejected (E319) for a version that was never released.
+- Rewrites and E319 now follow the group's final aligned versions, for Cargo, npm and Python.
+- If a run aborted with E319 naming a version your fixed group never released, re-run it.
+callisto-cli: patch

+**Python requirements on an epoch version keep the epoch.** Releasing a Python package that sits in a PEP 440 epoch no longer rewrites a dependent's `>=2!0.4.8` to `>=0.4.9`, which silently accepted every epoch-0 version such as 99.0.0.
+- Why it matters: the rewritten range now admits the new release and still rejects the versions the original rejected.
+- What changes: `==`, `~=`, `>=` and `>=X,<Y` requirements write `N!` on every bound, including the upper bound.
+- Limit: a Poetry caret or tilde has no epoch form, so one that needs rewriting for an epoch release fails the run with E319.
+callisto-cli: patch

+**An interrupted `version` run resumes only with its own workspace's plan.** Running `version` again after an interruption now refuses with `E340` if the plan would come from any directory other than this workspace's recorded tree, instead of writing another workspace's bump, notes and changelog here.
+- Delete the checkpoint ref named in the error and follow the `E121` steps, as for any refused resume.

docs/adr/0001-changesets-compatible-change-records.md:7:- `@changesets/cli` is JS-only. Polyglot teams already fake `package.json` proxies for Rust and Python packages and copy versions back with a hand-written sync script (docs/00-design.md §0).
docs/adr/0001-changesets-compatible-change-records.md:13:The human-written change record is a `.changeset/*.md` file in `@changesets/cli`'s format: YAML frontmatter mapping package names to `none`/`patch`/`minor`/`major`, then a Markdown summary. Compatibility means each tool reads the other's files; output is not byte-identical (callisto quotes names only when needed). `pre.json` is read in either Changesets shape and written back in the shape read: v2 (`mode`, `tag`, `initialVersions`, the applied `changesets` ids) or v3 (`mode` and `tag` only, applied changesets moved to `.changeset/pre/`); a cycle Callisto starts writes v2. Same `bump_version` semantics (no 0.x remap on an explicit major). Commit inference is opt-in per package (`release-trigger = "auto"`); an unset key resolves to `ReleaseTrigger::Changeset` (`crates/callisto-graph/src/walk.rs`). For an `auto` package, severity is the highest of its changeset entries and its inferred severity (VER-AGG-01, `docs/specs/versioning.json`).
